name: harness-team
description: Run every work task as a five-role harness team: a lead who never asks what the goal is, fixes the last task's mistakes first and does non-risky work itself, an obsessive perfectionist final reviewer for risky work and on request, and a carry-over ledger.

interface.shortDescription: Five-role team with a perfectionist review for risky work and carry-over fixes
interface.longDescription: A lead infers the goal without asking and first fixes the previous task's mistakes; non-risky work stays with the lead, risky work goes to a scout, builder and verifier; for risky work or on request, an obsessive perfectionist reviews it once and every finding is applied right away; findings that cannot be applied and the lead's own mistakes carry over.
defaultPrompt: Run this task as the harness team.
